summary: Full backend + frontend validation of Samvad Editorial Desk (Approve for Rewrite flow). All 9 pytest backend tests passed (CRUD, seed statuses, AI Gemini rewrite returning valid Devanagari Hindi, publish rules, 400/404 negatives). Frontend Playwright flow verified: dashboard loads with 5 seeded cards, Approve-for-Rewrite button is visible/clickable on Pending_Review card, click triggers AI rewrite (~few seconds), Hindi pane renders, status badge updates to Rewritten, Publish button appears and works, filter tabs (All/Pending/Rewritten/Published) filter correctly, Add News modal creates a new Pending_Review card visible in the grid.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); consider migrating to lifespan context manager.
approve-rewrite endpoint has no timeout on LLM call; a hanging Gemini call could block a worker. Consider asyncio.wait_for with a max timeout and a 504 response.
Seed runs on every startup only when collection is empty (idempotent) - good. No unique index on title, so duplicate manual entries are allowed (acceptable for MVP).
seed_data_creation: Seeded 5 items already provided by backend startup hook; test items created with TEST_ prefix are cleaned up in tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL from frontend/.env. AI rewrite via emergentintegrations gemini-3-flash-preview works reliably (~5-10s). Full happy path validated end-to-end.
rca of the issue: N/A - feature works as intended; original 'missing Approve for Rewrite button' has been fully addressed. Button renders on every Pending_Review card with data-testid approve-for-rewrite-btn-{id} and triggers AI rewrite that returns Devanagari Hindi and updates status.
